verdict.rationale: The platform provides employee-facing tools like a 'My Equity' view and an exercise workflow (with 83(b) generation and exercise windows shown via 'Exercise Now' buttons), which touch on equity mechanics, but there is no evidence of plain-language explanations of tax treatment or dilution for employees specifically. Missing for 10: plain-language tax treatment guidance, dilution explanations tailored to employees, and any educational/explainer content beyond transactional workflows.
